name: Ningbo Zhenyu Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Zhenyu Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of precision progressive stamping dies and downstream precision structural parts in China and internationally. The company offers iron cores for home appliance motors and molds for drive motors used in new energy vehicles. It also provides motor cores and lithium battery structural components, as well as precision parts and components for humanoid robots. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Ningbo, China.
